runtime: Production Next /dev, native arrival and HuntCanvas; no injected gameplay state or clock
scope: Atmospheric shutters and heating, natural triad handoff, safe remote pod controls, native in-memory suspend/resume, single-pod and ship exclusions, isolated reset/reload. No campaign durability, art approval or performance qualification.

checks.name: Native triad arrival keeps the three shutters folded in space
Actual atmospheric playback heats each pod and opens its panels before surface contact
The complete 62-second arrival hands off once to three physical capsules
X cannot arm beside the pods, or while one companion stays inside the safety radius
Walking the whole triad away enables arming and a second X cancels
Native pause and in-memory suspend/resume conserve the exact countdown
Resume completes one destruction and the native checkpoint cannot rearm it
Reset and reload deliberately create fresh isolated trials; a direct solo hunt has one pod
A native landed-ship hunt never creates a pod or its remote control
Every requested game image loads and all native sessions remain free of runtime errors and storage writes
